parameters.content:
## RainbowAI full automation integration (NOT LIVE)
Flow video via useapi.net requires a third-party paid subscription and according to its n8n template a paid Google AI video plan. These API nodes are an integration scaffold only; they are not connected to the active schedule. Do not place tokens in GitHub or plaintext node fields: use n8n credentials. The first job must complete, download the MP4, extract its final frame, upload that image as clip 2 startImage, then submit and poll clip 2. Render both clips to 20s using an actual external rendering service (n8n Cloud does not run FFmpeg directly), then upload privately. The separate existing webhook accepts a FINISHED MP4. No automatic production is configured until these services are validated.
